description.value: The Black Sheep Public House is a long-running neighbourhood pub established in 1987, voted the best pub in the Maple Ridge and Ridge Meadows area. It seats over 200 people and pours more than 18 beers on tap alongside an extensive food menu, with a full liquor store occupying an adjacent corner of the building. Situated just minutes from Golden Ears Park, it makes a solid stop for cyclists coming off the trails or riding the Fraser Valley routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at theblacksheeppub.ca is fully accessible and confirms an active, well-established pub and liquor store at 12968 232nd Street, Maple Ridge — operating since 1987 with 200+ seating. The menu includes items marked '(V)' confirming vegetarian options. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM address ('232 Street, Maple Ridge') is incomplete — missing house number and postal code; website confirms full address as '12968 232nd Street, Maple Ridge, BC V2X 6V2'.
OSM has no phone number recorded; phone 604.476.1008 sourced from website only.
Liquor store subpage contains a COVID-19 notice that may indicate stale content on that subpage, though the contact page shows current hours.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible pub and liquor store with a functioning website, confirmed address, and regular events. No grounds for exclusion.
